QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Affix the Love Tester
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #bDylan#k is making something with the ribbon. Go talk to Dylan.
QuestInfo.1: #bDylan#k tells you to give #bDelilah#k the #bribbon brooch#k made with the cardiotachometer. Delilah just arrived at Fantasy Theme World Main Gate.
QuestInfo.2: You gave #bDelilah#k the heartbeat sensor! Now return to #bDylan#k in Funky Station <1> and tell him the plan is in motion.

0.0: #i4036091#  \r\nTake a look. It looks just like a regular ribbon brooch with no secrets whatsoever! Good thing the sensor is small, eh? Can you give this ribbon brooch to Delilah when she arrives?

0.msg: Make sure you tell her how important it is to keep the brooch all day.

1.msg: #b(You'll have to convince Delilah to wear the brooch.)#k

no.0: How are you already tired? We've only just started!

default.0: I'll know the exact pace of Delilah's heartbeat if she wears the #bribbon brooch#k!

item.0: Uh... Weren't you going to give me something?\r\n(You can forfeit and start the quest over.)
